jobs.description:
Dreaming of a job where you don't have to rise early? As an afternoon shift mail sorter at PostNL, this dream can become a reality. You start your work in the afternoon, allowing you ample time for other activities! As a team member in the sorting center, you'll be sorting mail with your friendly colleagues, but PostNL doesn't expect you to be limited to just sorting. There are plenty of other work possibilities available through discussion! Does a gross hourly salary of €14.99, travel reimbursement, and free training opportunities sound appealing to you? Read on and apply today!

Manpower agency is looking for a Postal Worker for PostNL in the Zeist region, with the exact work location being Nieuwegein.

As a mail sorter, your primary task is, of course, sorting mail! This is done using a sorting machine. Additionally, there are various other work opportunities at PostNL. Are you inclined towards administrative tasks, or do you prefer getting physically involved? Through discussion, there are always options to take on different tasks!

What you'll get:

    - Gross hourly salary of €14.99 
    
- Travel reimbursement according to the PostNL collective labor agreement
    
- Gain logistics experience at a reputable company
    
- Work within a pleasant, friendly, and motivating team
    
- On-the-job training and the opportunity to be trained for multiple machines
    
- Part-time job of fifteen hours per week
    
- Free access to over two hundred training courses via Manpower Academy

    - Minimum age of eighteen
    
- Ability to work standing and lift heavier containers
    
- Proficient in Dutch and/or English for communication and safety instructions
    
- Availability for a minimum of three shifts per week
    
- A VOG (Certificate of Good Conduct) if required
    
- Personal transportation to commute to the workplace

Lastly, it would be beneficial if you live in (or near) Zeist, Nieuwegein, Utrecht, or Maarssen.

If you meet the requirements and are enthusiastic, don't wait

*tringgggg…* The alarm goes off early, and that doesn't make anyone happy. But for you, it’s not a problem! You get out of bed every morning with a big smile on your face. And we need that dose of kindness! :) Get started as a delivery driver at Albert Heijn in Bleiswijk. You make people happy every day! You have your own work van, and you also earn € 18,83 per hour! NICE! Do you want to know how to apply? #baanrader Then read on!

What we offer
- A top salary of € 18,83 per hour
- ​Loyalty program, get great discounts and presents
- Earn € 200, bring a friend!
- Flexible working hours
- Travel allowance
- A job with career opportunities!

Who you are
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, you are physically able to lift heavy crates. You enjoy working at different locations throughout the country if necessary! What you also need to know:

- You can communicate in English or Dutch;
- You are in possession of a driving license B;
- You are available at least two shifts per week and two Saturdays per month.

What will you do
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, you are the shopping carrier on wheels! Your working day starts by collecting the key and the route list at the collection desk. The first days, you will ride along with a buddy. You quickly grab some food from the refrigerator. Then it’s time to hit the road! You drive to the right addresses via your navigation. Once you get here, you scan the correct crates with groceries with a handheld scanner. You bring the groceries to the front door. You just need to complete the payment and then you're ready to go! At the end of the day, you return to the depot. Here, you clean your bus for the next day. Do you have questions about the route? Then you can contact planning & support! :)

Working days: Monday to Sunday.
Working hours: decide for yourself when you work between 7:00 AM and 11:00 PM.
